landslide.title: 🏔️ LANDSLIDE RISK ASSESSMENT
landslide.subtitle: Location-specific geotechnical & meteorological slope failure evaluation grid for North East India.
landslide.trackOnMap: 📍 Track Disaster Sector on Live Map ➔
landslide.confidenceNote: Score derived from Open-Meteo precipitation telemetry, DEM slope gradient & ISRO Bhuvan soil saturation.
landslide.action1: Avoid unnecessary transit along steep mountain slopes during heavy rain spells.
landslide.action2: Monitor regional BRO and PWD road clearance advisories before launching convoys.
landslide.action3: Ensure emergency survival rations, trauma kits, and satellite radios are pre-staged.
landslide.action4: Follow official local disaster authority (NDRF / SDRF) advisory alerts continuously.
landslide.sign1: New ground cracks or road asphalt displacement along hill edges.
landslide.sign2: Tilting trees, utility poles, or retaining wall bulges.
landslide.sign3: Sudden muddy water runoff or brown stream discharge from slopes.
landslide.sign4: Unusual rumbling sounds or small falling rock debris.
